blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: The current V3 wrapper tracks same-block received shares for redemption eligibility, but the reviewed transfer update does not add a holder blacklist. Upstream yzUSD and reserve-asset access exposure remains inherited.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Plasma block 33896602 on 2026-10-01, the canonical proxy resolves to verified StakedYuzuUSDV3 implementation 0x4ad9f1db810146b660eb863cc6f56649e0824a6e and ProxyAdmin 0x7392751a860a51694231c7a0b4a9c853f8169cf0; asset() remains yzUSD 0x6695c0f8706c5ace3bdf8995073179cca47926dc. The ProxyAdmin owner is now 48-hour TimelockController 0x2130457539612ae9838e0314cda1a8abbdb7cfbc, with the 4-of-5 Safe acting through proposer/executor/canceller roles. The verified V3 source overrides _update to track received shares for a same-block redemption guard; this is not a selective transfer-freeze mechanism. V3 also introduces role-managed mint/redeem throttles, pause and exit settings, and distribution controls, so the historical V1 claim of no transfer hook is not current. At Monad block 109541441 the implementation and ProxyAdmin remain 0xe536b80e7f859e72ad095d769da1da45b7312d53 and 0x7040b88de8a8e63b9dffe2250f8062dcc1ca7331, owned by the 12-hour timelock. Live upgrade paths can change these access controls. The single direct yzUSD dependency and its issuer-freezable reserve exposure remain inherited; neither the new timelock nor local absence of a blacklist removes that upstream adverse exposure.

oracleRisk.summary: syzUSD is Yuzu's staking wrapper over yzUSD; its share price accrues strategy yield and the wrapper does not expose a separate borrower collateral market or token-level liquidation oracle.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1b oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: Yuzu's syzUSD wrapper uses a share price/exchange rate to convert yzUSD into syzUSD shares and back as strategy yield accrues. That wrapper-local rate is a price-sensitive top-level redemption authority; syzUSD has no borrower-owned debt or separate liquidation branches, while underlying yzUSD remains a dependency.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Plasma remains the reviewed native syzUSD ERC-4626 issuance route; its CCIP LockReleaseTokenPool is cross-chain escrow assessed in Bridge Risk. At Plasma block 33896602, seven configured satellite selectors are present: the six reviewed EVM destinations plus Aptos mainnet. Aptos ledger version 7436709932 confirms the 6-decimal syzUSD metadata object, reciprocal Plasma pool/token binding, ManagedTokenPool 1.6.0, a sole pool store minter/burner and enabled rate limits. Published Move source enforces CCIP callback, remote-pool and limiter checks, while owner-controlled configuration and compatible package upgrades remain privileged surfaces; no unverified signer threshold or timelock protection is inferred. The Ethereum ProxyAdmin owner is a runtime-matched 12-hour TimelockController, while the Pharos proxy admin is a deployed contract whose controller's getMinDelay() returns 300 seconds; former EOA descriptions are superseded by chain-specific observations. Named EVM LayerZero peer probes remain empty except the one-sided Pharos pointer, which does not establish another active rail. Runtime chain-supply materiality remains a separate unresolved production input.

protocols.name: Chainlink CCIP
protocols.note: The current syzUSD representations use Chainlink CCIP burn/mint token pools under the issuer-owned CCT standard: BurnMintTokenPool 1.6.1 on Ethereum, Monad, HyperEVM, Sei, and Pharos, and BurnMintTokenPool 1.5.1 over a FactoryBurnMintERC20 1.6.2 token on Berachain. At the 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-05 observations, each pool was the live token's CCIP minter and burner holder, with Yuzu-owned router, remote-pool, and rate-limit configuration verified; LayerZero peers read zero everywhere except a one-sided Pharos-to-Plasma peer whose Plasma-side counterparty holds no peers.

Live peers(uint32) reads across EIDs 30100-30400 (including Plasma 30383, Ethereum 30101, Monad 30390) all return zero, so the LayerZero surface is exposed but carries no live peers today; the issuer's current documented transport is Chainlink CCIP, whose security-infrastructure page lists the syzUSD Token Manager lanes 'Plasma <> Monad / Ethereum / HyperEVM / Sei / Pharos' while the LayerZero page documents a Plasma-HyperEVM DVN configuration only. On the CCIP side, TokenAdminRegistry 0xce44363496abc3a9e53b3f404a740f992d977bdf maps this token to BurnMintTokenPool 0xd32ab76a165f1a716986ba8c58344e3df4397f5e (typeAndVersion 1.6.1) whose getToken() returns this token, getRouter() returns 0x13b3332b66389b1467ca6ebd6fa79775ccef65ec matching the Chainlink CCIP HyperEVM directory, owner() and getRateLimitAdmin() return the Yuzu EOA, getSupportedChains() returns only the Plasma selector 9335212494177455608, getRemoteToken(Plasma) returns canonical syzUSD 0xc8a8df9b210243c55d31c73090f06787ad0a1bf6, and inbound (capacity 3,300,000 syzUSD, refill 38.19444 syzUSD/s) and outbound (capacity 3,000,000 syzUSD, refill 34.72222 syzUSD/s) rate limits are enabled. TokenAdminRegistry 0x0944c3fb1db7d165336569221995b31cbe6c8a55 maps the token to this BurnMintTokenPool 1.5.1 whose getToken() returns the token, getRouter() returns 0x71a275704c283486fba26dad3dd0db78804426ef matching the Chainlink CCIP Berachain directory, owner() returns the Yuzu EOA while getRateLimitAdmin() returns the zero address (1.5.1 pool; rate-limit administration unset, owner retains reconfiguration), getSupportedChains() returns only the Plasma selector 9335212494177455608, getRemoteToken(Plasma) returns canonical syzUSD 0xc8a8df9b210243c55d31c73090f06787ad0a1bf6, and inbound (capacity 3,300,000 syzUSD, refill 38.19444 syzUSD/s) and outbound (capacity 3,000,000 syzUSD, refill 34.72222 syzUSD/s) rate limits are enabled. The issuer key-addresses page lists this token on Berachain chainID 80094, while the CCIP page's Token Manager lane list stops at Pharos; the on-chain TokenAdminRegistry registration, the canonical Plasma LockReleaseTokenPool's supportedChains() now including the Berachain selector 1294465214383781161 with getRemoteToken() mapping to this address, and the live bridged supply establish the CCIP rail regardless of that documentation lag.
